title: PreExecutionArtifactSnapshot v1
description: The exact artifact set, authoritative contexts, source revision and authoring revision one independent pre-execution reviewer read. This document is a NON-AUTHORITATIVE Draft-07 structural projection generated from the package's canonical pre-execution-contract definition. It is not a semantic authority: a Draft-07 match is not contract validity — use the authoritative runtime entry point named in $comment.

unitId.description: Roadmap or fix-unit identity; at most 128 characters. Opaque: compared, never parsed, and never echoed back by a diagnostic.

sourceRevision.description: Exact repository revision the artifacts were read at (SHA-1 or SHA-256 object id).

artifactRevisionId.description: Authoring-owned revision identity; at most 128 characters. Opaque: compared, never parsed, and never echoed back by a diagnostic.

artifacts.description: Ordered artifact rows; 1..32, ordered by UTF-8 path bytes.

contexts.description: Authoritative context bindings; 0..16, ordered by kind then identifier.

parentSpecSnapshotDigest.description: Digest of the reviewed Product snapshot: required for a feature Plan snapshot, exactly null at the SPEC stage and for a fix unit (it has no Product half to bind, D6).

allOf.description: [spec-stage-has-no-parent] A SPEC snapshot is the root of its own lineage.
[plan-stage-requires-parent] A Plan snapshot of a FEATURE unit binds the exact reviewed Product snapshot.
[fix-unit-has-no-product-parent] A fix unit has no Product snapshot, so its Plan snapshot binds no parent.

kind.description: Artifact role inside the stage's authoritative set.

allOf.description: [path] must not be an absolute path (leading "/")
[path] must not be a Windows drive-letter path
[path] must not end with a separator
[path] must not contain an empty segment

path.description: Normalized repository-relative path; at most 1024 characters.

selector.description: How the bound bytes were selected out of the file.

byteLength.description: UTF-8 length of the SELECTION (a Product projection is smaller than its file), at most 4194304 bytes.

digest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the selected bytes.

identifier.description: Stable identifier (a roadmap row, an issue number such as #146, a snapshot id); at most 160 characters.

digest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the context bytes when present; exactly null when absent.

allOf.description: [present-context-has-digest] A present context binds a digest.
